scenarios.title: Foundation & HTML5 Canvas Delivery
scenarios.preconditions: Node HTTP static server running on http://localhost:8080

scenarios.title: WebSocket Interception & Fibonacci Jitter Engine
scenarios.preconditions: WebSocket route hook page.routeWebSocket registered on ws://localhost:8080/ws
scenarios.action: Intercept server WS state frames and apply D(n) = min(1000 * Fib(n), 8000)
scenarios.observedResult: Frames intercepted. Step 1: 1000ms, Step 2: 1000ms. Step 7 Cap: 8000ms (Capped: true).
scenarios.expectedResult: Fibonacci delay applied accurately with 8000ms maximum cap.

scenarios.title: Embedded rAF Canvas Pixel Detector & T0 Capture
scenarios.preconditions: Canvas rendering state transitioning from LOADING Gray to ACTIVE Blue
scenarios.action: In-browser rAF loop samples Canvas getImageData at (350, 250) until [0, 85, 255] confirmed
scenarios.observedResult: RGB transition confirmed: [0, 85, 255]. T0 captured in browser clock: 2546.60ms.
scenarios.expectedResult: Active Blue pixel transition validated via getImageData and T0 measured in browser performance.now().

scenarios.title: Single-Clock Race Timing & Chained Interaction
scenarios.action: Dispatch Hover -> MouseDown -> Drag 15px X-axis -> MouseUp -> Click
scenarios.expectedResult: 30ms <= ΔT <= 100ms verified in single browser clock domain with exact 15px drag sequence.

scenarios.title: Signed 2D Coordinate Drift & Bounded Circuit Breaker
scenarios.preconditions: Target coordinates shift or frame freshness stalls prior to action dispatch
scenarios.action: Calculate signed offsets (dx, dy), check version freshness, enforce max 3 retries
scenarios.observedResult: Signed offset (+15, +10) -> (315, 210). Stale version flagged. Max retries (3) tripped controlled failure.
scenarios.expectedResult: Signed offset target calculation updated, stale frames invalidated, and circuit breaker limits retries to 3.

scenarios.title: Corrupted Payload & Structured Exception Boundary
scenarios.preconditions: WebSocket interceptor mutates balance payload to "1e+7" (Scientific notation string corruption)
scenarios.action: Client canvas_app.js parses incoming JSON and executes validateBalanceRepresentation()
scenarios.observedResult: Exception boundary element displayed: Visible=true, Code=CORRUPTED_PAYLOAD. Silent rendering prevented.
scenarios.expectedResult: Corrupted representation detected, silent rendering blocked, and DOM Exception Boundary UI activated.
